fields.disappearance: 1436 Śaka (1514), on the bank of the Gaṅgā, on the way from Vṛndāvana to Gauḍa with Rūpa Gosvāmī (Bhakti-ratnākara 1.668–669)
fields.place: Born in Bāklā-Candradvīpa; grew up and lived at Rāmakeli (Gauḍa), head of Husain Shah's mint

fields.disappearance: shortly after the birth of his youngest son Vallabha (Anupama), in Bāklā-Candradvīpa (Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna)
fields.notes:
He was the father of Rūpa and Sanātana Gosvāmī.

Father of Sanātana, Rūpa and Vallabha (Anupama); grandfather of Jīva Gosvāmī. Only son of Mukunda; Bharadvāja-gotra Yajurvedī brāhmaṇa (Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna).

fields.appearance: about 1405 Śaka (1483), at Tālakhaḍi, Jessore (Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna, entry Padmanābha Cakravartī)
fields.disappearance: 1510 Śaka (1588) (Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna), Āṣāḍha Kṛṣṇa Aṣṭamī (B. V. Tīrtha; other texts: Śrāvaṇa Kṛṣṇa Aṣṭamī, or Śrāvaṇa Śukla Aṣṭamī), at Khadiravana (Khāyarā); samādhi by Śrī Yugala-kuṇḍa, and at the Gokulānanda temple
fields.place: Tālakhaḍi, Jessore (East Bengal); Vṛndāvana: Kiśorī-kuṇḍa at Umarāo near Chatravana, later Khadiravana (Khāyarā)
fields.guru: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu (Prema-vilāsa 20; Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna); other texts: Advaita Ācārya, Sanātana Gosvāmī

fields.appearance: 1428 Śaka (1506), at Jhāmaṭapura (Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna, which also gives 1418 Śaka with a query); other dates given: 1496; 1482 Śaka (1560)
fields.disappearance: Āśvina Śukla Dvādaśī, after the disappearance of Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī (year not known; c. 1615 in another text); samādhi at Rādhākuṇḍa
fields.place: Born at Jhāmaṭapura, near Kāṭoyā and Naihāṭī (Barddhamān district); lived in Vṛndāvana and at Rādhākuṇḍa until the end of his life
fields.disciples: Mukunda Dāsa Gosvāmī, Viṣṇudāsa (Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna); Narottama dāsa Ṭhākura (śikṣā, in the record)
fields.works: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Śrī Govinda-līlāmṛta, Sāraṅga-raṅgadā (commentary on the Kṛṣṇa-karṇāmṛta); attributed: Svarūpa-varṇana (Svarūpa-nirṇaya)

fields.disappearance: Kārtika Śukla Caturdaśī, in Vṛndāvana; samādhi beside Rūpa Gosvāmī's in the courtyard of the Rādhā-Dāmodara temple
fields.disciples: Caitanya dāsa (pūjārī of Śrī Govinda-deva), Kumudānanda Cakravartī (other reading: Mukundānanda), Premī Kṛṣṇadāsa

fields.place: Devavana, near Hardwar (Sahāranpur district); Vṛndāvana (service of Śrī Rādhā-ramaṇa)
